<STBG 2,0><BGM 0,0,503><TALK 5><NAME 7><CHAR 5,1,10,0,0><CV 11,13>Hold on a moment!
You can't pass through here right now.

<NAME 7><TALK 5><CHAR 5,0,10,0,7><CV 11,16>Ah, seems a monster
broke the bridge...

<NAME 8>We're doing repairs now.
I'm Sage, the foreman...

<CHAR 5,0,10,0,8><CV 11,7>That's right!
By your look, you're explorers, huh?
Could I ask a small favour?

To reach the far shore we need
a ≪Rocket Lance≫, but its fuel —
<COL C70101FF>≪Monster Body Fluid≫</COL> — is short.

<NAME 1><TALK 1><CHAR 1,0,1,0,8><CV 1,11><COL C70101FF>≪Monster Body Fluid≫</COL>, you say...
We can't have you stuck either,
so we'll go look for it!

<NAME 8><TALK 5><CHAR 5,0,10,0,0><CV 11,2>Sorry 'bout this!
<COL C70101FF>≪Monster Body Fluid≫</COL> should be
gatherable from any monster!
